newsitem.title: USA: ASI to sell 9.9 mln American Standard shrs.
newsitem.headline: ASI to sell 9.9 mln American Standard shrs.

text.p: American Standard Cos Inc said on Tuesday it filed a registration statement with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission for its principal stockholder, Kelso ASI Partners LP, to exit its investment in American Standard.
ASI Partners planned to sell about 9.9 million American Standard shares, plus an underwriters' over-allotment option of another 1.5 million shares, in a secondary offering, the company said.
American Standard said it would buy about 7.9 million shares from ASI Partners at the same price as the offering. This purchase would be financed under its revolving line of credit, the company said.
Individual Kelso principals and investors in ASI Partners could opt to retain their shares, the company said.

In conjunction with the repurchase, the company said it would issue ASI Partners warrants to buy three million shares of American Standard common stock at an exercise price of $10 above the per share price of the offering.
The company was not immediately available to comment on the price at which shares would be sold and repurchased.
Goldman Sachs & Co, Morgan Stanley & Co, Smith Barney Inc and S.G. Warburg & Co were managing underwriters of the offering, the company said.
